I've read the current repo state from dump.txt and the terminal log, and I have a full plan for the next slice — but I hit the tool-use ceiling before I could write and package the files. Here's exactly where things stand.

First: nothing is currently failing
claude-terminal.txt is from the same session as dump.txt (commit b6a2892) and it's green throughout:

dotnet test — 971 total / 0 failed / 956 succeeded / 15 skipped
bash scripts/ci_local.sh --with-all — all six gates passed
MYRESTAURANT_E2E=1 — 15 total / 0 failed / 12 succeeded / 3 skipped
run.sh --smoke, --containers-only, quick_tunnel.sh — all fine
The 15 skips under a plain dotnet test are the E2E scenarios opting out (MYRESTAURANT_E2E unset). The 3 skips under MYRESTAURANT_E2E=1 are the three unimplemented §16.3 scenarios, each carrying PendingHarnessExtension. So there's no failing assertion to fix — Slice 12 landed clean.

What the next step is
§16.3 scenario 10 — Counter_ClosesSitting_TableFlipsToSettledAndTotalsMatch. I traced every surface it touches and the design is settled:

Arrangement: administrator + soup (6.50) + pie (14.00) + table + a real counter account (§3.7 → §3.5 forced password change, reusing Slice 12's CreateStaffAccountAsync / SignInWithPasswordAsync / CompleteForcedPasswordChangeAsync). The counter account is warranted here for the opposite reason to scenario 9's: §6.5.8 admits an administrator's corrective events after a close, so asserting "read-only" as an administrator asserts the wrong side of the claim.
Guest sends soup ×1 + pie ×2; the administrator's kitchen board fulfills the soup only, so the bill is mixed and §5.3's pending-line warning has exactly one line to name.
Seven independent computations of the same number get asserted equal: the till header (SQL sitting_bill), the confirm prompt's CurrentTotalAmount, the post-close stamped header, .counter-settle-total (C# sum), the guest's "Table total" and "Your total" on the other circuit, and the settled_total_amount column.
Flip assertions: .counter-readonly present, Settled total label, zero .counter-line-actions, no staff-add section, no close button, no spurious .counter-detail-corrected, the pie still badged "with the kitchen" (§5.3's knowingly-charge record), the guest's picker/send/removal checkboxes gone with nobody touching the phone, ReadOpenSittingAsync now null, and the table moved from the board's floor list to "Settled today".
